title: NOTIFICATIONS
caption:
Opt-in wake for Pay in Chat and contact share
while Basic is closed. Off by default.
closedAppHint:
Opaque only (“New Pay message”). Never amounts, memos, or addresses. Classic Bitcoin receives still catch up when you open the app — no tray.

Tip: do not use system “Force stop”. Swipe away is fine. On Xiaomi / Samsung, allow unrestricted battery for Basic so tray wake works while the app is closed.
permDenied: OS permission: denied — enable in system settings
alertAndroidOnlyBody: Closed-app push ships on Android first. iOS later.
alertNostrRequiredBody: Create or import a Nostr identity first (Settings → Nostr identity).
alertPermissionBody: Allow notifications in system settings to wake Basic for Pay messages while the app is closed.
nostrMissing: Nostr identity: missing — required to register.
nostrReady: Nostr identity: ready (npub registered in background).
notAndroidBuild: This build is not Android — toggle disabled.
